title: Signup Open | “Data Insight × Intelligent Future” — 2024 AIGC Application Development Summit
summary: At the Beijing “Chinese Language Inventory 2023” ceremony co-hosted by the National Language Resources Monitoring & Research Center, the Commercial Press, and XinhuaNet, ChatGPT took the year’s top international buzzword and generative AI entered the year’s top-ten new phrases —
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event signup · December 27, 2023 · Unique Capital / Unique Research

At the Beijing “Chinese Language Inventory 2023” ceremony co-hosted by the National Language Resources Monitoring & Research Center, the Commercial Press, and XinhuaNet, ChatGPT took the year’s top international buzzword and generative AI entered the year’s top-ten new phrases — a signal of the wave OpenAI and peers have unleashed. Adoption is still early; capability already exceeds many expectations.

As an industry investment bank focused on globalization and AIGC, Unique Capital and its research media Unique Research spent the past year connecting hundreds of generative-AI startups and publishing 100+ research pieces.

What did founders achieve? Which commercial practices and tech trends matter? Where does the sector go next? To welcome a high-velocity 2024, Unique Capital joins leading generative-AI companies and investors under the theme “Data Insight, Intelligent Future” for the 2024 AIGC Application Development Summit.

Format

Three blocks — AI accelerating paradigm shift, AI empowering industries, and globalization & tech stacks — with 67 top guests and 18 hours of dense programming.

GenAI’s productivity shock has the industry sketching a new future: Copilots and Agents expand creativity and execution; AI fused with VR/AR, blockchain, and the metaverse pushes experiential leaps. Hard questions remain: valuable commercial scenes, correct application of new tools, and more equal, safer environments for everyone.

When & where

If you want answers — or want to invent the next layer — join us in Shanghai on 24 January for the 2024 AIGC Application Development Summit. Signup is open (see CN page / QR for registration links).

2 CN images; attach on ingest. KEEP as event signup package.

— END —
